growers_name_check.name: growers_name_check
growers_name_check.value: char_length("growers"."name") between 1 and 200 and "growers"."name" = btrim("growers"."name") and "growers"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

package_types_name_check.name: package_types_name_check
package_types_name_check.value: char_length("package_types"."name") between 1 and 200 and "package_types"."name" = btrim("package_types"."name") and "package_types"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

pallet_types_name_check.name: pallet_types_name_check
pallet_types_name_check.value: char_length("pallet_types"."name") between 1 and 200 and "pallet_types"."name" = btrim("pallet_types"."name") and "pallet_types"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

yield_types_name_check.name: yield_types_name_check
yield_types_name_check.value: char_length("yield_types"."name") between 1 and 200 and "yield_types"."name" = btrim("yield_types"."name") and "yield_types"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

access_grants_shape_check.name: access_grants_shape_check
access_grants_shape_check.value:
(
        ("access_grants"."scope" = 'global' and "access_grants"."grower_id" is null and "access_grants"."kind" is null and "access_grants"."reference_table" is null)
        or ("access_grants"."scope" = 'reference' and "access_grants"."access" = 'write' and "access_grants"."reference_table" is not null and "access_grants"."grower_id" is null and "access_grants"."kind" is null)
        or ("access_grants"."scope" = 'palletSets' and "access_grants"."reference_table" is null)
      )

pallets_net_weight_grams_check.name: pallets_net_weight_grams_check
pallets_net_weight_grams_check.value: "pallets"."net_weight_grams" >= 0 and (("pallets"."voided" = false and "pallets"."net_weight_grams" = "pallets"."gross_weight_grams" - "pallets"."package_tare_grams" * "pallets"."package_amount" - "pallets"."pallet_tare_grams") or ("pallets"."voided" = true and "pallets"."net_weight_grams" = greatest(0, "pallets"."gross_weight_grams" - "pallets"."package_tare_grams" * "pallets"."package_amount" - "pallets"."pallet_tare_grams")))
